Golden S1G transmit vectors, generated by the TGah Tx reference code
(IEEE 802.11-14/0631r2, "11ah Tx Reference Code", compatible with 802.11ah
Draft 1.1) under GNU Octave. The reference code itself is not in this repo;
these files are its output only.

Each file: a header line (bw, short, mcs, length_psdu, nsym, ndbps, aggr),
`init` (7-bit scrambler seed as the reference prints it), `x` (PSDU bits
before the FCS), `sig` (SIG information bits), `n`, then n lines of
"re im" baseband samples at the base rate (1 or 2 Msps) with the
reference's one-sample overlap windowing.
